input.question: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
input.evidence: Difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment can be computed by `Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

input.question: Between San Diego and Santa Barbara, which county offers the most number of schools that does not offer physical building? Indicate the amount.
input.evidence: 'Does not offer physical building' means Virtual = F in the database.

expect.gold_sql: SELECT County, COUNT(Virtual) FROM schools WHERE (County = 'San Diego' OR County = 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(Virtual) DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
input.evidence: the highest longitude refers to the school with the maximum absolute longitude value.

expect.gold_sql: SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: Among the accounts who have approved loan date in 1997, list out the accounts that have the lowest approved amount and choose weekly issuance statement.
input.evidence: 'POPLATEK TYDNE' stands for weekly issuance

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.account_id FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1997' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY T1.amount LIMIT 1

input.question: Provide the IDs and age of the client with high level credit card, which is eligible for loans.
input.evidence: the credit card is high-level refers to card.type = 'gold'; eligible for loans refers to disp.type = 'OWNER'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T1.client_id, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T3.birth_date) FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2.disp_id = T1.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'gold' AND T1.type = 'OWNER'

input.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
input.evidence: triple-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '#'; carcinogenic refers to label = '+'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

input.question: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
input.evidence: TR000 is the molecule id;

expect.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element LIMIT 3

input.question: Calculate the total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing the element phosphorus or bromine.
input.evidence: triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; phosphorus refers to element = 'p'; bromine refers to element = 'br'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')

input.question: What are the cards belong to duel deck a? List the ID.
input.evidence: duel deck a refers to duelDeck = a;

expect.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck = 'a'

input.question: What's the Italian name of the set of cards with "Ancestor's Chosen" is in?
input.evidence: Italian is a language which refers to language = 'Italian'; with "Ancestor's Chosen" in the card set refers to name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT translation FROM set_translations WHERE setCode IN ( SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' ) AND language = 'Italian'

input.question: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
input.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; converted mana cost higher than 5 refers to convertedManaCost > 5; unknown power refers to power = '*' or T1.power is null

expect.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5

input.question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
input.evidence: play format refers to format; banned status refers to status = 'Banned'; the highest number of banned status refers to MAX(COUNT(status = 'Banned'))

expect.gold_sql: WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2.format, T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN MaxBanned MB ON MB.format = T2.format WHERE T2.status = 'Banned'

input.question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
input.evidence: "Eliciting priors from experts" is the Title of post; owner refers to DisplayName

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

input.question: What is the display name of the user who last edited the post "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation"?
input.evidence: "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation" is the Title of post; user who last edited refers to LastEditorUserId

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

input.question: Calculate the average view count of each post tagged as 'humor' and list the title and the comment of each post.
input.evidence: tagged as  'humor' refers to tag = '<humor>'; comment of the post refers to Text; average view count = AVG(ViewCount)

expect.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.ViewCount), T2.Title, T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.PostId  WHERE T2.Tags = '<humor>' GROUP BY T2.Title, T1.Text

input.question: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
input.evidence: student badges refers to badge's name = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(Date) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(Date) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2010), Count (Name)) *100, Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2011), Count(Name)) * 100)

expect.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2010', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) - CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2011', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'

input.question: How many comments were added to the post with the highest score?
input.evidence: the highest score refers to MAX(Score);

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId GROUP BY T1.Id ORDER BY T1.Score DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: Who is the dumbest superhero?
input.evidence: the dumbest superhero refers to MIN(attribute_value) where attribute_name = 'Intelligence'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Intelligence' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value LIMIT 1

input.question: List down at least five superpowers of male superheroes.
input.evidence: male refers to gender = 'Male'; superpowers refers to power_name;

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.power_id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T4.id = T1.gender_id WHERE T4.gender = 'Male' LIMIT 5

input.question: How many heroes have stealth power?
input.evidence: stealth power refers to power_name = 'Stealth';

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.hero_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Stealth'

input.question: How many percent of female heroes were published by Marvel Comics?
input.evidence: percent = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender = 'Female' WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'), COUNT(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')), 100); female heroes refers to gender = 'Female'; Marvel Comics refers to publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

expect.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'Female' AND T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100 FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id

input.question: In the race No. 45, for the driver who had the Q3 time as 0:01:33, what is his abbreviated code?
input.evidence: race number refers to raceId; had the Q3 time as 0:0M:SS refers to q3 LIKE 'M:SS%'

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.code FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 45 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:33%'

input.question: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of the races were hosted in Germany?
input.evidence: European Grand Prix races refers to races.name = 'European Grand Prix';percentage = divide(COUNT(races where country = Germany and name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'),COUNT(races where name = 'Europearn Grand Prix'))*100

expect.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.circuitId) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix'

input.question: Among the drivers that finished the race in the 2008 Chinese Grand Prix, how many of them have participated in Formula_1 races?
input.evidence: COUNT(raceID) > 0 reveals that this driver participated in races; drivers who finished the race refers to time has value.

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T1.driverId FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2008 AND T1.time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.driverId HAVING COUNT(T2.raceId) > 0 )

input.question: State code numbers of top 3 yougest drivers. How many Netherlandic drivers among them?
input.evidence: youngest driver refers to Max (year(dob)); Netherlandic and Dutch refer to the same country

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 ORDER BY JULIANDAY(T1.dob) DESC LIMIT 3) AS T3 WHERE T3.nationality = 'Dutch'

input.question: What is full name of the racer who ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race held in the Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008?
input.evidence: Ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race refer to MIN(q3); 2008 is the year of race; full name of racer = forename, surname

expect.gold_sql: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND T3.year = 2008 AND T3.circuitId IN ( SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' ) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1, INSTR(q3, '.') - INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS REAL) + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ASC LIMIT 1

input.question: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?
input.evidence: most matches end as draw refers to MAX(SUM(home_team_goal = away_team_goal)); 2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016';

expect.gold_sql: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' AND t1.home_team_goal = t1.away_team_goal GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY COUNT(t1.id) DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
input.evidence: finishing rate refers to finishing; highest average finishing rate = MAX(AVG(finishing)); highest football player refers to MAX(height); shortest football player refers to MIN(height);

expect.gold_sql: SELECT A FROM ( SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Max' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player ) UNION SELECT AVG(finishing) result, 'Min' A FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player ) ) ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 1

input.question: How was Francesco Migliore's attacking work rate on 2015/5/1?
input.evidence: Francesco Migliore refers to player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'; on 2015/5/1 refers to date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

expect.gold_sql: SELECT t2.attacking_work_rate FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.`date` LIKE '2015-05-01%' AND t1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'

input.question: Please state the finishing rate and curve score of the player who has the heaviest weight.
input.evidence: finishing rate refer to finishing; curve score refer to curve; heaviest weight refers to MAX(weight)

expect.gold_sql: SELECT id, finishing, curve FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = ( SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1

input.question: Which top 4 leagues had the most games in the 2015-2016 season?
input.evidence: in the 2015-2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016'; league with most games refers to League.name where MAX(COUNT(id))

expect.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t2.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t1.name ORDER BY COUNT(t2.id) DESC LIMIT 4

input.question: What is the percentage of female patient were born after 1930?
input.evidence: female refers to Sex = 'F'; patient who were born after 1930 refers to year(Birthday) > '1930'; calculation = DIVIDE(COUNT(ID) where year(Birthday) > '1930' and SEX = 'F'), (COUNT(ID) where SEX = 'F')

expect.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'

input.question: Name the ID and age of patient with two or more laboratory examinations which show their hematoclit level exceeded the normal range.
input.evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)); patient with two or more laboratory examinations refers to COUNT(ID) > 2; hematoclit level exceeded the normal range refers to HCT > = 52;

expect.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID IN ( SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE HCT >= 52 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ID) >= 2 )

input.question: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
input.evidence: normal level of anti-centromere refers to CENTROMEA IN('-', '+-'); normal level of anti-SSB refers to SSB IN('-', '+-'); male refers to Sex = 'M'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

expect.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'M'

input.question: Calculate the total average cost that Elijah Allen spent in the events on September and October.
input.evidence: Elijah Allen is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; The 5th and 6th string of the expense_date in the expense table can refer to month; events in September and October refers to month(expense_date) = 9 OR month(expense_date) = 10

expect.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.last_name = 'Allen' AND T1.first_name = 'Elijah' AND (SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '09' OR SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '10')

input.question: Which event has the lowest cost?

input.question: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.

input.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
